content.text: Faraday Future just launched 9 new robot configurations across five models — including a 95 cm humanoid starting at $9,990 and industrial quadrupeds priced above $70K. The interesting part isn't the lineup size: it's the attempt to span classrooms, research, security and inspection with one robotics stack. Can one platform really serve all four?

visual.headline: Faraday Future launches 9 robot configurations
visual.subheadline: From a $9,990 classroom humanoid to industrial quadrupeds: one robotics stack is being stretched across education, research, security and inspection.
visual.alt_text: Dark editorial card summarizing Faraday Future's September 19 robotics launch, highlighting nine configurations across humanoid and industrial robot models and their target use cases.
